thread:
samir: Quick heads-up — MedSecure POC kickoff tomorrow. They asked for a single ZIP with: SOC 2 summary, ISO27001 scope excerpt, signed pen-test letter template, and staging KMS access notes. Also asking: will Dedicated capacity change pricing for POC?

jordan: I can pull the SOC2 summary + pen-test attestation template. Which pen-test signatory do they want — vendor or our SOC partner?

samir: Prefer Redwood-signed letter referencing our external pentest partner. They want a letter that says pen-test occurred within last 12 months and high severity fixes tracked.

maria: For KMS notes — MedSecure needs to know if staging keys are customer-managed or Redwood-managed for the POC. Their security team pushes for CMK in their KMS.

lily: Pricing question — if they spin up a Dedicated trial pool for 2 weeks, we normally offer a short-term rate card add-on. @maria can you confirm ops impact?

maria: Ops impact: Dedicated short trials are possible but require reservation of GPU slots; recommend using burst-capacity on Hosted if latency not critical. Dedicated will add a setup lead time (1 business day) and a temporary minimum commit: we can do a letter of intent for trial (no full contract).

jordan: Draft of pen-test letter snippet below — fine to use but needs legal signatory.

```
Redwood Inference
Penetration Test Attestation
Date: <DATE>
To whom it may concern,
Redwood Inference attests that an external penetration test was conducted on our service infrastructure on <TEST_DATE> by <PEN_TESTER>. High and critical findings were remediated or tracked in our vulnerability backlog (ticket refs available upon request). For more details please contact security@redwood.com.
Sincerely,
Redwood Security Team
```

samir: That looks great. Jordan — can you attach the signed PDF once legal signs? Customer expects the signed letter in the evidence ZIP.

jordan: Yep — I'll route to legal. Also attaching SOC2 summary and ISO scope excerpt.

ops-bot: Uploaded: /evidence/medsecure/2026-03-22/SOC2-summary.pdf (sha256: abc123...)

lily: Question for pricing: if they use Hosted + burst for POC, cost estimate ~ $1,200 for perf targets they shared. Dedicated estimate (2-week reserved mini-pool) bump ~ $7k one-time setup + prorated reserve. This is rough — need EngOps confirmation.

maria: EngOps confirms: Dedicated 2-week reservation would block capacity and incur minimum short-term fee. If they need isolation, that's the path; otherwise recommend Hosted w/ private subnet + KMS integration.

samir: Action items: Jordan — get signed pen-test letter and attach. Maria — confirm KMS integration steps for customer-managed CMK and a short note for the ZIP. Lily — finalize price estimate and include note about SLA differences. I'll package ZIP and send to customer by EOD tomorrow.

jordan: Will do. FYI legal flagged one line about vulnerability disclosure; I'll redline then share for sign-off.

maria: KMS note: for POC we can support customer-managed keys in staging by providing temporary IAM role + key policy; ops will need the customer AWS acct ID. I'll draft snippet for the ZIP.

samir: Great. If anyone wants to jump on a 15m to finalize wording before I send, ping me. :thumbsup:

lily: I'll hop on at 3pm.
